verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Containers product that runs 'code written in any programming language, built for any runtime, as part of apps built on Workers', and the Sandbox SDK is 'built on Containers' with a full Linux environment per sandbox. That shows container workloads are supported, but only alongside Workers apps, and the pack never shows a Docker image or Dockerfile being deployed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of deploying Docker images or Dockerfiles, a documented container deploy workflow (e.g. a Wrangler container deploy command), standalone container deployment outside a Worker, and independent hands-on corroboration.
